blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Particle picking in cryo-electron microscopy is commonly formulated as an object-detection problem in which individual particles are represented by bounding boxes, a natural representation for globular particles but a poor match for filaments that can extend across an entire micrograph. Existing methods reconstruct filament trajectories by linking local predictions in a separate post-processing stage, decoupling detection from instance formation and creating potential ambiguities at gaps and crossings. Directly preserving filament identity is particularly useful for polymorphic specimens, where segments originating from the same filament should remain associated. However, learning such instance-level representations is challenging because expert centerline annotations are scarce and costly to obtain. We introduce CryoTracer, a synthetic-to-real framework that addresses this limitation through procedural micrograph generation, transformer-based polyline prediction, and specimen-specific fine-tuning. Procedural pretraining exposes the model to diverse filament geometries, intersections, and imaging conditions before adaptation using a limited number of fully annotated experimental micrographs. CryoTracer represents filaments as ordered centerline polylines and optimizes their geometry using an orientation-invariant discrete Fréchet objective, enabling consistent learning regardless of tracing direction. Evaluation on established and newly expert-annotated datasets shows that CryoTracer improves instance-level filament recovery over existing particle-detection approaches. These results establish end-to-end polyline prediction as a practical alternative to detection-and-linking pipelines for recovering complete filament instances with limited micrograph annotation budgets. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cryotracer/cryotracer

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) uses two-dimensional images of vitrified specimens to determine three-dimensional macromolecular structures. Software packages such as RELION Scheres (2012) and cryoSPARC Punjani et al. (2017) require an initial particle-picking step to identify particles in noisy micrographs. For filamentous specimens, this step must recover centerlines and distinguish individual filaments. Helical reconstruction workflows extract overlapping segments along these traces. Grouping segments by their parent filament allows an entire filament to be inspected or excluded and classification evidence to be combined across its segments. This grouping is particularly useful for specimens containing multiple structural polymorphs that must be separated before reconstruction Frey et al. (2024) . For example, α \alpha -synuclein is a major component of the protein aggregates associated with Parkinson’s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies Spillantini et al. (1997) ; Schweighauser et al. (2020) ; Yang et al. (2022) ; Enomoto et al. (2025) . Its fibrils can occur in distinct structural polymorphs Li et al. (2018) , and filament-level subset selection has been used when processing mixed α \alpha -synuclein polymorph datasets Lövestam et al. (2023) . Preserving filament identity during picking requires following each filament through curves, crossings, and low-contrast regions. A fading signal can resemble an endpoint, while a crossing can leave several possible continuations. A tracer must consider the surrounding filament geometry to avoid splitting one filament into fragments or joining different filaments. Preparing real training data requires annotators to mark each filament’s endpoints and place points along its centerline. At crossings or gaps in the visible signal, they must decide which segments belong to the same filament.
blocks.zh: Cryo-electron显微镜(cryo-EM)使用活化标本的二维图像来测定三维宏分子结构. 诸如RELION Scheres(2012年)和CryoSPARC Punjani等软件包(2017年)需要初步的取出颗粒步骤,以识别有噪声的微图中的颗粒. 对于有丝状标本,这一步骤必须取回中心线并区分单个有丝. 螺旋重建工作流程沿着这些痕迹提取出重叠部分. 用母丝进行分组,可以检查或排除整个丝状物,并将其各个部分的分类证据合并。 这种组合对包含多个结构多态的标本特别有用,在重建Frey等(2024年)前必须分离. 例如:α-α-synuclein是与帕金森病和与Lewy体 Spillantini等(1997年)有关的蛋白质集合的主要成分; Schweighauser等(2020年); Yang等(2022年); Enomoto等(2025年). 其纤维可以发生于不同的结构多态性Li等(2018年)中,在加工混合α-α-synuclein多态性数据集Lövestam等(2023年)时,已经使用了丝状级子集选择. 在采摘过程中保留丝状特征,需要通过曲线,过道口和低相干区域跟踪每一个丝状. 一个正在消失的信号可以类似于一个终点,而一个过道可以留下几个可能的续作. 追踪器必须考虑周围的丝状几何来避免将一丝状分裂成碎片或加入不同的丝状. 准备真正的训练数据需要注释者标记每个丝线的终点并沿着其中心线放置点. 在可看见信号的交叉口或相隔处,它们必须决定哪个部分属于同一种丝.

blocks.en: Established particle pickers such as crYOLO and Topaz assemble filament traces from local predictions. crYOLO’s filament mode requires training on manually annotated filaments Wagner et al. (2020) . It connects local bounding boxes into traces without directly predicting a complete ordered centerline. Topaz’s filament extension Lövestam and Scheres (2022) selects regions above a threshold in a heatmap of likely particle locations and reduces them to thin lines. It then detects straight segments and merges nearby segments with similar orientations into longer traces. In both workflows, filament continuity is reconstructed through geometric rules with user-selected parameters, which required expert tuning in our comparisons. On α \alpha -synuclein, both methods produced more numerous, shorter traces than the annotated filaments, a pattern consistent with fragmentation despite substantial spatial coverage.
blocks.zh: 已建成的取粒器,如cryYOLO和Topaz从局部预测中组装出丝状痕迹. CRYOLO的丝质模式需要手动附加说明的丝质训练 瓦格纳等 (2020). 它将局部的边框连接成痕迹,而不直接预测一个完整的有秩序的中心线. 黄玉石的丝状延伸Lövestam和Scheres(2022年)在可能粒子位置的热图中选择出一个阈值以上的区域并把它们缩小为细线. 然后检测出直分并将相近有类似取向的分会合并为较长的分会. 在这两个工作流程中,丝线连续性都是通过几何规则和用户选定的参数来重建的,这需要在我们的比较中进行专家调整. 在α-α-synuclein上,这两种方法产生的痕迹比附加说明的丝丝要多,更短,这种图案虽然覆盖了大量的空间,却与分化一致.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce CryoTracer, a synthetic-to-real system that predicts each filament as an ordered five-point centerline from a full micrograph. Direct centerline prediction makes filament continuity part of the learning task, removing the need to assemble traces from local detections using geometric linking rules. The model adapts RF-DETR Robinson et al. (2026) with curve proposals refined through deformable attention and successive decoder stages. An orientation-invariant discrete Fréchet objective supervises curve matching and regression. To reduce reliance on expert annotations, procedural micrograph generation provides centerlines, endpoints, and filament identities by construction, while varying curvature, density, crossings, width, and background appearance. This enables pretraining on diverse examples without tracing each micrograph manually. Fine-tuning on real annotations then adapts the model to the specimen and acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了CryoTracher,一个合成到现实的系统,它预言每个丝线都是从完整的微图中被订购出五分中线. 直接中线预测使得丝线连续性成为了学习任务的一部分,消除了利用几何连接规则从局部检测中组分痕迹的需要. 该模型对RF-DETR Robinson等人(2026年)进行了调整,通过可变形的注意和相继的解码相改进了曲线建议. 取向偏差离散的Fréchet目标监督曲线匹配和回归. 为了减少对专家说明的依赖,程序微图生成通过构造提供中心线,端点和丝状特征,同时提供不同的曲率,密度,跨度,宽度和背景外观. 这样就可以在不人工追踪每个微图的情况下,对各种实例进行预先培训。 然后对真实的注解进行精细调整,使模型适应标本和获取条件.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We introduce a synthetic-to-real filament-tracing system that learns filament continuity through direct centerline prediction and reduces reliance on expert annotations through procedural pretraining followed by specimen-specific fine-tuning. • We release filament annotations for EMPIAR-10022 and evaluate on an in-house α \alpha -synuclein dataset comprising 325 expert-annotated micrographs from 11 reconstruction sessions. • We compare CryoTracer with established cryo-EM methods under standard and limited-annotation regimes, using instance-level and spatial-overlap metrics to distinguish complete filament recovery from local coverage.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐款如下。 我们采用合成-正真丝状跟踪系统,通过直接中线预测来学习丝状连续性,并通过程序预训,然后对标本进行特异微调来减少对专家说明的依赖。 我们公布EMPIAR-10022的丝状说明,并评价内部的α-α-synuclein数据集,其中包括来自11次重建会议的325个专家说明微图。 将CryoTracher与标准和有限说明制度下的已确立的Cryo-EM方法相提并论,使用实例级和空间重叠度量度来区分完整的丝回与局部覆盖.

blocks.en: Below, we present CryoTracer , a method for detecting filament instances in high-resolution, noisy micrographs. First, we describe our proposed architecture, which modifies RF-DETR to enable a polyline-based representation of detected structures. Next, we explain a two-stage training paradigm that addresses the problem of limited annotated real data. The key components of our method are illustrated in Figure 1 .

blocks.en: Each initial polyline is predicted independently from a single feature-map location 𝐅 l , x , y \mathbf{F}_{l,x,y} . Consequently, the initial predictions have two limitations. First, multiple proposals may correspond to the same filament, while other filaments may receive no proposal. blocks.en: 4.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.4 限制

blocks.en: CryoTracer remains sensitive to ambiguous filament geometry. At crossings and overlaps, predicted traces can connect distinct filaments or recover only part of an instance. The fixed five-point representation may also limit the fidelity of traces with complex curvature. Synthetic pretraining reduces reliance on real training annotations but does not eliminate it. Our results cover two datasets with specimen-specific fine-tuning. Generalization to unseen specimens and acquisition conditions requires further evaluation. The next step is to test whether improved filament recovery translates into more effective downstream classification and reconstruction.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
CryoTracer learns to trace individual cryo-EM filaments by predicting ordered
centerline polylines, making geometry and instance identity explicit in the
model output. The framework combines procedural synthetic pretraining,
orientation-invariant Fréchet supervision, and specimen-specific
fine-tuning. On EMPIAR-10022 and α \alpha -synuclein, it achieves higher
complete-instance mF1 than Topaz and crYOLO in both standard and
limited-annotation regimes, and outperforms the RELION Amyloid
baseline on α \alpha -synuclein. Ablations support the value of synthetic
initialization, with larger gains when real training annotations are scarce.
Together with the overlap metrics, these results show why filament tracing
should be evaluated for both spatial coverage and instance continuity.
We release new EMPIAR-10022 centerline annotations
to support further evaluation.

blocks.en:
Topaz and crYOLO use the same supervised partitions as CryoTracer.
Their configuration required substantial manual tuning by a cryo-EM expert,
including dataset-specific picking and filament-tracing settings, which were
then fixed for evaluation. Topaz is trained for 10 epochs with an expected particle count
of 200, using downsampling factors of four and six and extraction thresholds
of − 3 -3 and − 4 -4 for EMPIAR-10022 and α \alpha -synuclein, respectively. crYOLO uses
filament mode with expert-selected box sizes of 400 and 512 pixels,
approximately twice the filament width to include surrounding image context.
The filament-width argument ( -fw ) is set to the corresponding box
size, with tracing box distances of 40 and 51 pixels, respectively. These
expert-selected picking and tracing settings are independent of the tighter
physical filament widths used for spatial-overlap evaluation below.
CryoTracer uses the same optimization recipe and inference thresholds across
both datasets and regimes, without corresponding dataset-specific manual
tuning. Its specimen-specific model-weight fine-tuning remains part of
training. This comparison of tuning effort is qualitative. The experiments
compare configured systems without matched hyperparameter-search or compute
budgets, and do not quantify expert time or the number of tuning trials.
